podcast.title: Declared Influence
podcast.body: White Lies are among a partial list of artists and bands who have publicly stated that they have been influenced by Joy Division in some way. "You too, arcade fire, smashing pumpkins, nine inch nails, to pesh mode, sisters of mercy, ministry, chain addiction, the smiths, Bjork, Jesus and Marychain, Moby, primal scream, the Charlotains, Interpol, editors, white lies, Frans Ferdinand. I could go on, but I think you get the point."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's the Big Deal About Joy Division?
